_doc: Every tuning constant in the game (GDD 'Tuning constants'). Shared contract: read by every lane. Each entry is {value, unit, meaning}. 'value' is the number the rules use; 'unit' and 'meaning' are documentation and are never read by the rules. Values are the GDD's untested starting numbers: change one only with the owner's approval, in a PR that contains nothing else. Adding a new constant is fine (additive); renaming or removing one needs a proposal in docs/proposals/. Keys starting with '_' are comments and are ignored by loaders.

BASE_HYPE.meaning: Hype per turn before Gear. Each Dude's hype_per_turn starts here.

BASE_DRAW.meaning: Cards drawn per turn before Gear. Each Dude's draw_per_turn starts here.

EXPOSED_MULT.meaning: Damage multiplier against an Exposed target. Applied at step 4 of the GDD damage order.

NOODLE_MULT.meaning: Damage multiplier for an attacker with Noodle Arms. Applied at step 2 of the GDD damage order.

HUNGOVER_MULT.meaning: Guard multiplier for a Hungover Dude, applied to Guard gained from cards.

BROKEN_ARM_MAX_REDUCTION.meaning: Attack reduction when every arm is broken. With k of n arms broken an enemy's attack damage is multiplied by 1 - BROKEN_ARM_MAX_REDUCTION * k / n (step 3 of the damage order).

ICK_BASE_NORMAL.meaning: Starting Ick threshold for normal enemies (solo; co-op scales it by the HP multiplier, rounded up).

ICK_BASE_RIVAL.meaning: Starting Ick threshold for Rivals (solo; co-op scales it by the HP multiplier, rounded up).

ICK_BASE_BOSS.meaning: Starting Ick threshold for bosses (solo; co-op scales it by the HP multiplier, rounded up). The Hangover uses 15, which is not a constant yet because the final boss is out of scope.

ICK_THRESHOLD_STEP.meaning: Added to an enemy's Ick threshold each time it is Grossed Out.

BRO_METER_MAX.meaning: Bro Meter value needed for a Bro Move. The meter runs from 0 to this value.

HP_SCALE_PER_EXTRA_PLAYER.meaning: Enemy HP added per player beyond the first, as a fraction of solo HP. Gives the GDD multipliers 1.0 / 1.8 / 2.6 / 3.4.

EXTRA_ENEMY_PARTY_SIZE.meaning: Party size at which Brawls gain one enemy.

MULTI_TARGET_PARTY_SIZE.meaning: Party size at which single-target enemy attacks hit 2 Dudes.

REVIVE_HP_FRACTION.meaning: HP a Passed Out Dude wakes with after a won fight.

TURN_TIMER_SECONDS.meaning: Default co-op turn timer. Not used by the rules core, which never reads the clock; the host's session layer enforces it.

REJOIN_GRACE_SECONDS.meaning: How long a disconnected player's seat is held. Used by the session layer, not the rules core.

SCAFFOLDING_MAX.meaning: Most Scaffolding Ethan can hold. Out of scope for the solo slice; listed because the GDD defines it.

NAP_WAKE_ON_ASSIST.meaning: Whether an Assist card played on a Napping Ethan wakes him. Out of scope for the solo slice; listed because the GDD defines it.

START_DOLLA_BILLS.meaning: Dolla Bills each Dude holds at the start of a run (G20).

BASE_BREW_SLOTS.meaning: Brew slots each Dude starts with, before Gear such as Fanny Pack (GDD Items; G22).

CARD_REWARD_CHOICES.meaning: Cards offered at each card reward, before Gear such as Beer Goggles (G22).

BRAWL_DOLLA_MIN.meaning: Smallest Dolla Bills reward from a Brawl (GDD Node types; G22).

BRAWL_DOLLA_MAX.meaning: Largest Dolla Bills reward from a Brawl (GDD Node types; G22).

BRAWL_BREW_CHANCE.meaning: Chance that a Brawl also rewards a Brew (GDD Node types; G22).

RIVAL_DOLLA_MIN.meaning: Smallest Dolla Bills reward from a Rival (GDD Node types; G22).

RIVAL_DOLLA_MAX.meaning: Largest Dolla Bills reward from a Rival (GDD Node types; G22).

TAILGATE_NAP_HEAL.meaning: HP a Nap at The Tailgate restores (GDD Node types; G22). Keg Level 5 lowers it later.

CARD_REMOVE_BASE.meaning: Price of the first card removal at Baileys (GDD Prices at Baileys; G22).

CARD_REMOVE_STEP.meaning: Added to the card removal price after each removal (GDD Prices at Baileys; G22).

BRO_METER_SOLO_CARDS.meaning: In solo play, the Bro Meter gains 1 for every this-many cards played in a turn (GDD Bro Meter; G22).

MAX_TRIGGER_DEPTH.meaning: Most Power triggers that may fire inside one another in one chain (a Power whose effects set off another Power, and so on). The effects of a trigger fired by a card, move or turn start run at depth 1, a trigger they set off runs at depth 2, and no trigger fires from effects already at this depth. Stops a Power that feeds itself (an enemy_buffed Power that buffs an enemy) from looping forever. An int, 1 or more; a fight refuses to start otherwise. Added by task 031; the GDD is silent on this (gap G53), and the value is a suggestion, not the GDD's.

REWARD_ODDS_COMMON.meaning: Chance a card offered as a reward is common (G21). The three REWARD_ODDS_ values add up to 1.

REWARD_ODDS_UNCOMMON.meaning: Chance a card offered as a reward is uncommon (G21).

REWARD_ODDS_RARE.meaning: Chance a card offered as a reward is rare (G21).

PRICE_CARD_COMMON.meaning: Price of a common card at Baileys (G21).

PRICE_CARD_UNCOMMON.meaning: Price of an uncommon card at Baileys (G21).

PRICE_CARD_RARE.meaning: Price of a rare card at Baileys (G21).

PRICE_GEAR_COMMON.meaning: Price of a common Gear at Baileys (G21).

PRICE_GEAR_UNCOMMON.meaning: Price of an uncommon Gear at Baileys (G21).

PRICE_GEAR_RARE.meaning: Price of a rare Gear at Baileys (G21).

PRICE_SHAKE_COMMON.meaning: Price of a common Brew, sold as Shake at Baileys (G21).

PRICE_SHAKE_UNCOMMON.meaning: Price of an uncommon Brew, sold as Shake at Baileys (G21).

PRICE_SHAKE_RARE.meaning: Price of a rare Brew, sold as Shake at Baileys (G21).

SHOP_CARD_COUNT.meaning: Cards for sale at each Baileys (G21).

SHOP_GEAR_COUNT.meaning: Gear for sale at each Baileys (G21).

SHOP_SHAKE_COUNT.meaning: Brews for sale, as Shake, at each Baileys (G21).

MAP_ROWS.meaning: Rows of nodes on a floor map before the boss row (gap G18). Row 1 is all Brawls, row MAP_ROWS (the row before the boss) is all The Tailgate, and one boss row with one Boss node follows. Must be 2 or more.

MAP_MIN_NODES_PER_ROW.meaning: Fewest nodes in one map row, rows 1..MAP_ROWS (gap G18). The boss row always has exactly one node. At least 1, at most MAP_MAX_NODES_PER_ROW.

MAP_MAX_NODES_PER_ROW.meaning: Most nodes in one map row, rows 1..MAP_ROWS (gap G18). Each row's size is drawn from the map stream between MAP_MIN_NODES_PER_ROW and this value.

MAP_MAX_LINKS.meaning: Most nodes in the next row one map node links to (gap G18: 1 to 2). Every node links to at least 1, so every path reaches the boss. MAP_MAX_NODES_PER_ROW must be at most MAP_MIN_NODES_PER_ROW times this value, or some rows cannot all be reached.

NODE_SHARE_BRAWL.meaning: Share of Brawl nodes among a floor map's rows 1..MAP_ROWS (GDD 'Node types'). The six NODE_SHARE_ values must total 100. Rounded to whole nodes per floor; row 1's Brawls count toward it.

NODE_SHARE_RIVAL.meaning: Share of Rival (elite fight) nodes among a floor map's rows 1..MAP_ROWS (GDD 'Node types'). Rounded to whole nodes per floor.

NODE_SHARE_SIDE_QUEST.meaning: Share of Side Quest nodes among a floor map's rows 1..MAP_ROWS (GDD 'Node types'). Rounded to whole nodes per floor.

NODE_SHARE_TAILGATE.meaning: Share of The Tailgate nodes among a floor map's rows 1..MAP_ROWS (GDD 'Node types'). Rounded to whole nodes per floor; the pre-boss row's Tailgates count toward it.

NODE_SHARE_BAILEYS.meaning: Share of Baileys (shop) nodes among a floor map's rows 1..MAP_ROWS (GDD 'Node types'). Rounded to whole nodes per floor.

NODE_SHARE_LOOT.meaning: Share of Loot nodes among a floor map's rows 1..MAP_ROWS (GDD 'Node types'). Rounded to whole nodes per floor. Whether a Loot node holds a Mimic Cooler is decided by encounters (gap G19), not by the map.

MULTI_TARGET_COUNT.meaning: How many different Dudes a single-target enemy attack hits once the party has MULTI_TARGET_PARTY_SIZE players (GDD 'Difficulty scaling': 2 at 3 and 4 players). Below that party size it hits 1. Added by task 011; not in the GDD's constants table.
